corrections.reason: Visual inspection of Col 1 L32 shows 8 Fidels (ነ-ግ-ሬ-ች-ኋ-ለ-ሁ-ና) without an intervening አ.
In Classical Ge'ez (John 15:19) and on the printed page, the plural possessive pronoun is spelled with 1st-order አ (እሊአሁ), not 4th-order ኣ.
The word እንጂ splits across L05-L06; the glyph on L06 has the 3rd-order right foot (ጂ), not 6th-order ጅ.
The printed glyph has the shortened left leg of 4th-order ባ (ባሪ = 'servant/slave', matching Col 1 L20 ባሪ ጌታው), misread as 1st-order በ.
The third character is 6th-order ድ followed by ዋ (ይሰድዋችኋል), not a redundant ዷዋ.
Both the printed glyph and canonical Ge'ez grammar (nominative subject of ኮኖሙ in John 15:22: ወእምኢኮኖሙ ጌጋይ) have 6th-order ይ (ጌጋይ), not 1st-order የ.
